dct_description_sm: Strengthening Fathers Programs provide holistic intervention and prevention services and supports for men who are or have been abusive in their intimate relationships. These services and supports are provided within the larger continuum of services for families affected by intimate partner violence. Intimate partner violence may include physical, sexual, verbal, emotional, psychological, social, and financial violence and abuse

Les programmes Strengthening Fathers fournissent des services d'intervention et de prévention holistiques et des soutiens aux hommes qui sont ou ont été violents dans leurs relations intimes. Ces services et mesures de soutien sont fournis dans le cadre d'un continuum plus large de services destinés aux familles touchées par la violence conjugale.
